observations: Historical auto-aim ranks admitted candidates by cursor alignment, then distance and stable key; the source explicitly includes a no-cursor-cone case, so an off-axis selection is not itself a demonstrated defect. Finite input admission and each caller's range/visibility checks remain open.

Animation angle, length, positive duration and response owners distinguish signed and nonnegative values, units, and serde admission. Their exposed arithmetic includes deliberate saturation or limit behavior in some cases; finite intermediate results, native boundary consumers and contract-preserving operations require independent review.

Animation sample ticks and spans are distinct, with checked, saturating and explicitly wrapping operations for different clock purposes. The module exports these owners and declares many children; reading its index does not credit child implementations or independent lenses.
